requirements.title: Run OCI-compliant container images
requirements.description: Execute container images that comply with OCI Image Specification v1.1 from any OCI-compliant registry
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All images from Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR, GCR run without modification
requirements.technical_notes: Must implement OCI Runtime Spec v1.2 for container execution. Use runc-compatible hooks.
requirements.verification: Integration tests with images from 5+ registries

requirements.title: Container lifecycle operations
requirements.description: Support create, start, stop, restart, kill, remove operations on containers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: CLI commands complete within 2x of runc performance
requirements.technical_notes: Use cgroups v2 freezer for stop. Signal handling via pidfd.
requirements.verification: Benchmarks vs runc for each operation

requirements.title: Container pause/unpause
requirements.description: Suspend and resume container processes using cgroup freezer
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Processes suspended/resumed without termination
requirements.technical_notes: cgroups v2 cgroup.freeze interface. Requires CAP_SYS_PTRACE for user ns.
requirements.verification: State preservation tests across pause/resume cycles

requirements.title: Container exec
requirements.description: Execute commands inside running containers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Interactive and detached modes supported
requirements.technical_notes: Use nsenter via setns() syscall. Allocate pty for interactive mode.
requirements.verification: Interactive terminal tests, detached execution tests

requirements.title: Container logs
requirements.description: Stream and retrieve container stdout/stderr output
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Real-time streaming and historical log access
requirements.technical_notes: Log driver abstraction. Default to json-file driver. Support journald.
requirements.verification: Log integrity tests, streaming latency tests

requirements.title: Container inspect
requirements.description: Retrieve detailed container metadata in JSON format
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Docker-compatible JSON schema for tooling interoperability
requirements.technical_notes: Schema must match Docker API v1.45 inspect response structure.
requirements.verification: JSON schema validation against Docker schema

requirements.title: Health checks
requirements.description: Execute container health check commands at configurable intervals
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK directive supported
requirements.technical_notes: Parse HEALTHCHECK from image config. Support --health-cmd override.
requirements.verification: Health state transition tests, timeout handling

requirements.title: Restart policies
requirements.description: Automatic container restart based on policy
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Behavior matches Docker restart policy semantics (no, on-failure, always, unless-stopped)
requirements.technical_notes: Implemented in ferro-mgr daemon. Persist restart state across daemon restarts.
requirements.verification: Restart behavior tests for each policy type

requirements.title: Resource limits
requirements.description: Enforce memory, CPU, and PID limits on containers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: cgroups v2 unified hierarchy enforcement
requirements.technical_notes: Use cgroups v2 controllers: memory.max, cpu.max, pids.max. Support both absolute and relative limits.
requirements.verification: OOM kill tests, CPU throttling tests, PID limit enforcement

requirements.title: Environment and labels
requirements.description: Pass environment variables, labels, and annotations to containers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Full Docker -e, --label, and OCI annotation support
requirements.technical_notes: Environment via container process env. Labels stored in container state DB.
requirements.verification: Environment injection tests, label query tests

requirements.title: Pull images from OCI registries
requirements.description: Download container images from OCI-compliant registries
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR, GCR, Harbor, Quay.io tested
requirements.technical_notes: Implement OCI Distribution Spec v1.1. Support bearer token and basic auth.
requirements.verification: Pull tests from each supported registry

requirements.title: Push images to OCI registries
requirements.description: Upload container images to OCI-compliant registries
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Authentication via docker config.json and credential helpers
requirements.technical_notes: Chunked upload for large layers. Resume interrupted pushes.

requirements.title: Content-addressable store
requirements.description: Store image layers with Blake3 content hashing for deduplication
requirements.acceptance_criteria: File-level deduplication across layers; 40%+ storage reduction vs Docker
requirements.technical_notes: Blake3 for speed (10GB/s). Store by content hash. Reference counting for GC.

requirements.title: Zstd compression
requirements.description: Use Zstandard compression for image layers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: 2x+ compression speed vs gzip at comparable ratios
requirements.technical_notes: zstd level 3 default. Support gzip for compatibility.

requirements.title: Lazy image pulling
requirements.description: Start containers before full image download with on-demand file fetch
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Container starts before full image download; manifest-only initial fetch
requirements.technical_notes: FUSE filesystem for lazy loading. Track fetched ranges. Background full pull.
requirements.verification: Startup time comparison: lazy vs full pull

requirements.title: Dockerfile build
requirements.description: Build container images from Dockerfile
requirements.acceptance_criteria: 95%+ Dockerfile directive compatibility (documented exceptions only)
requirements.technical_notes: Support: FROM, RUN, CMD, LABEL, MAINTAINER, EXPOSE, ENV, ADD, COPY, ENTRYPOINT, VOLUME, USER, WORKDIR, ARG, ONBUILD, STOPSIGNAL, HEALTHCHECK, SHELL
requirements.verification: Build comparison tests against Docker BuildKit

requirements.title: ferrofile.toml build
requirements.description: Build images from declarative TOML specification
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Declarative build specification with static analysis capability
requirements.technical_notes: TOML schema with type checking. Support import from Dockerfile.
requirements.verification: Schema validation, conversion tests from Dockerfile

requirements.title: Multi-stage builds
requirements.description: Support multi-stage Dockerfile builds
requirements.acceptance_criteria: COPY --from= and named stages supported
requirements.technical_notes: Track stage dependencies. Enable selective stage rebuilding.
requirements.verification: Multi-stage build tests with complex stage graphs

requirements.title: Build cache
requirements.description: File-level build cache for incremental builds
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Single file change invalidates only that file, not entire COPY layer
requirements.technical_notes: Blake3 hash per file. Cache metadata in SQLite. TTL-based eviction.

requirements.title: Image management operations
requirements.description: Tag, list, remove, and prune images
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Standard image management operations
requirements.technical_notes: Reference counting. Safe deletion with running container check.
requirements.verification: CRUD operation tests, prune efficiency tests

requirements.title: CVE scanning
requirements.description: Scan images for known vulnerabilities
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Integration with vulnerability databases (NVD, OSV)
requirements.technical_notes: Background sync of vulnerability DB. Offline scanning mode.
requirements.verification: Detection rate tests against known vulnerable images

requirements.title: Vector-indexed deduplication
requirements.description: Use vector embeddings to identify similar (not identical) content
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ruvector embeddings identify similar content for dedup
requirements.technical_notes: Optional feature. Compute embeddings for file content. Similarity threshold configurable.
requirements.verification: Deduplication rate tests on similar image sets

requirements.title: Bridge networking
requirements.description: Default network mode with virtual bridge and port mapping
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Containers communicate via virtual bridge; port mapping to host
requirements.technical_notes: Create ferro0 bridge. veth pairs per container. NAT via eBPF or iptables.
requirements.verification: Container-to-container communication tests, port mapping tests

requirements.title: Host networking
requirements.description: Container shares host network namespace
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Container shares host network namespace
requirements.technical_notes: Skip network namespace creation. Direct host network access.
requirements.verification: Network isolation tests, host network access tests

requirements.title: None networking
requirements.description: Container has only loopback interface
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Container has loopback only
requirements.technical_notes: Create network namespace with only lo. No external connectivity.

requirements.title: Container DNS
requirements.description: Container-to-container DNS resolution within a network
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Containers resolve each other by name within a network
requirements.technical_notes: Embedded DNS server. Container name -> IP mapping. Forward external DNS.
requirements.verification: DNS resolution tests across container pairs

requirements.title: Custom networks
requirements.description: Create and manage named networks with configurable subnets
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Named networks with configurable subnets
requirements.technical_notes: Network driver abstraction. Bridge driver default. Store network config in SQLite.

requirements.title: eBPF packet forwarding
requirements.description: Replace iptables with eBPF for packet forwarding
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No iptables rules created; no conflicts with host firewall
requirements.technical_notes: Use aya crate for eBPF. Fallback to iptables on kernel <5.10.
requirements.verification: iptables rule verification, packet flow tests

requirements.title: WireGuard overlay
requirements.description: Encrypted cross-host container networking
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Cross-host container communication with transparent encryption
requirements.technical_notes: WireGuard kernel module integration. Key management via ferro-mgr.

requirements.title: Port mapping
requirements.description: Forward host ports to container ports
requirements.acceptance_criteria: TCP and UDP port forwarding
requirements.technical_notes: NAT rules via eBPF or iptables. Support port range mapping.
requirements.verification: TCP and UDP port forwarding tests

requirements.title: IPv6 support
requirements.description: Dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 networking
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Dual-stack networking for containers
requirements.technical_notes: Enable IPv6 on bridge. SLAAC or DHCPv6 for container addresses.

requirements.title: Bandwidth limiting
requirements.description: Per-container network rate limiting
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Per-container egress/ingress rate limiting via eBPF
requirements.technical_notes: Token bucket in eBPF. Enforce at network interface level.

requirements.title: Named volumes
requirements.description: Persistent storage that survives container lifecycle
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Persistent storage across container lifecycle
requirements.technical_notes: Volume management in SQLite. Support local and NFS backends.
requirements.verification: Volume persistence tests across container removal

requirements.title: Bind mounts
requirements.description: Mount host directories into containers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Host directory mounted into container
requirements.technical_notes: Resolve symlinks. Handle permission mapping in user namespaces.
requirements.verification: Bind mount tests with various permissions

requirements.title: tmpfs mounts
requirements.description: In-memory filesystem mounts
requirements.acceptance_criteria: In-memory filesystem for sensitive or ephemeral data
requirements.technical_notes: Mount with size limit. Support exec/noexec options.

requirements.title: Volume drivers
requirements.description: Plugin system for external storage backends
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Extensible storage backend support
requirements.technical_notes: Plugin interface via gRPC. Example drivers: Ceph, S3, NFS.

requirements.title: OverlayFS storage driver
requirements.description: Default copy-on-write filesystem
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Efficient copy-on-write layer management
requirements.technical_notes: Multiple lower layers. Metacopy for metadata efficiency.

requirements.title: Read-only rootfs
requirements.description: Immutable container filesystem
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Immutable container filesystem with writable overlay
requirements.technical_notes: Mount root as read-only. Writable overlay on /var, /tmp, etc.

requirements.title: Volume backup/restore
requirements.description: Export and import volume data
requirements.acceptance_criteria: CLI commands for volume data export/import
requirements.technical_notes: Tar archive format. Incremental backup support.

requirements.title: Rootless by default
requirements.description: Run containers without root privileges
requirements.acceptance_criteria: User namespace isolation without root privileges
requirements.technical_notes: Map container root to unprivileged host user. /etc/subuid, /etc/subgid for ID mapping.
requirements.verification: Rootless execution tests, privilege escalation tests

requirements.title: Seccomp profiles
requirements.description: Syscall filtering with default and custom profiles
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Default profile blocks dangerous syscalls; custom profiles loadable
requirements.technical_notes: Default profile based on Docker's. JSON format. libseccomp bindings.
requirements.verification: Syscall blocking tests, custom profile loading tests

requirements.title: AppArmor/SELinux
requirements.description: Mandatory Access Control integration
requirements.acceptance_criteria: MAC enforcement for container processes
requirements.technical_notes: Generate per-container profiles. Support existing profiles.

requirements.title: Capability dropping
requirements.description: Drop all Linux capabilities by default
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Only explicitly granted capabilities available to container
requirements.technical_notes: Use caps crate. Drop all, add requested. Validate capability strings.

requirements.title: Read-only rootfs production default
requirements.description: Immutable filesystem in production mode
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Configurable via flag; default differs for dev vs prod profiles
requirements.technical_notes: Profile-based defaults. --profile=dev|prod|secure.

requirements.title: No-new-privileges
requirements.description: Prevent privilege escalation via setuid/setgid
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Processes cannot gain privileges via setuid/setgid
requirements.technical_notes: Set PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS via prctl. Always enabled.

requirements.title: Image signature verification
requirements.description: Verify Cosign/Sigstore signatures before running
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Cosign/Sigstore signature verification before run
requirements.technical_notes: Fetch signatures from OCI registry. Verify against public key or Fulcio.

requirements.title: eBPF security monitoring
requirements.description: Real-time syscall auditing and anomaly detection
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Real-time syscall auditing and anomaly detection
requirements.technical_notes: Tracepoint eBPF programs. Feed events to ferro-mind for analysis.
requirements.verification: Audit log tests, anomaly detection tests

requirements.title: Encrypted container communication
requirements.description: Quantum-resistant encryption for container-to-container traffic
requirements.acceptance_criteria: QuDAG-based quantum-resistant encryption option
requirements.technical_notes: Optional feature. Integration with QuDAG library.

requirements.title: Audit logging
requirements.description: Structured logging for compliance requirements
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Structured JSON logs for compliance requirements
requirements.technical_notes: Log all container operations. Include user, timestamp, action, resource.

requirements.title: docker-compose.yml compatibility
requirements.description: Parse and execute docker-compose version 3.x files
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Version 3.x compose files parsed and executed
requirements.technical_notes: Support services, networks, volumes, configs, secrets top-level keys.
requirements.verification: Compose file parsing tests, execution tests

requirements.title: Native compose subcommand
requirements.description: Built-in compose support without external tool
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No separate tool installation required
requirements.technical_notes: ferrocrate compose up/down/ps/logs/... commands.

requirements.title: Service dependency ordering
requirements.description: Start services in dependency order with health conditions
requirements.acceptance_criteria: depends_on with condition support
requirements.technical_notes: Topological sort for start order. Wait for health checks.

requirements.title: Service scaling
requirements.description: Scale service replicas dynamically
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ferrocrate compose up --scale web=3
requirements.technical_notes: Track replicas in state DB. Generate unique container names.

requirements.title: Environment file support
requirements.description: Variable substitution from .env files
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Variable substitution in compose files
requirements.technical_notes: Parse .env file. Support ${VAR:-default} syntax.

requirements.title: Profile support
requirements.description: Selective service activation via profiles
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Named profiles to enable/disable services
requirements.technical_notes: Filter services by profile. Default profile for untagged services.

requirements.title: Watch mode
requirements.description: Automatic rebuild on source file changes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Automatic container rebuild on source file changes
requirements.technical_notes: inotify for file watching. Debounce rapid changes.

requirements.title: WASM neural inference
requirements.description: Sub-millisecond resource prediction via WASM neural networks
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Sub-1ms prediction latency; zero external API calls
requirements.technical_notes: ruv-FANN compiled to WASM. wasmtime runtime. No network calls.

requirements.title: Predictive resource allocation
requirements.description: Pre-allocate resources based on learned patterns
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Memory/CPU pre-allocation based on learned usage patterns
requirements.technical_notes: Train on container metrics. Predict next-hour resource needs.

requirements.title: Intelligent restart
requirements.description: Diagnose before restarting failed containers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Diagnostic analysis before restart; configuration adjustment if pattern detected
requirements.technical_notes: Analyze exit code, logs, metrics. Recommend config changes.

requirements.title: Cost-tiered AI routing
requirements.description: Route AI requests to optimal backend based on complexity
requirements.acceptance_criteria: WASM (free) -> local LLM (cheap) -> Claude API (complex) decision hierarchy
requirements.technical_notes: Complexity scoring. Threshold-based routing.

requirements.title: claude-flow agent orchestration
requirements.description: Multi-agent swarm for complex debugging
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Multi-agent swarm for complex debugging and remediation
requirements.technical_notes: MCP protocol integration. Lazy-load Node.js subprocess.

requirements.title: Anomaly detection
requirements.description: Flag resource usage anomalies with recommendations
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Resource usage anomalies flagged with severity and recommendation
requirements.technical_notes: Statistical anomaly detection. Severity scoring.

requirements.title: Build cache optimization
requirements.description: Vector similarity for improved cache hits
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Learned similarity for cache hit improvement beyond exact hash matching
requirements.technical_notes: ruvector embeddings for file content. Similarity threshold.

requirements.title: Natural language queries
requirements.description: Ask questions about container state in natural language
requirements.acceptance_criteria: "ferrocrate ask 'why did my web server crash?'" with claude-flow analysis
requirements.technical_notes: Route to Claude API via claude-flow. Context from logs, metrics, state.

requirements.title: Self-learning
requirements.description: Learn from operational patterns over time
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ruvector stores and retrieves operational patterns; improves over time
requirements.technical_notes: Pattern storage in ruvector. Retrieval for similar situations.

requirements.title: AI opt-out
requirements.description: Disable all AI features with single flag
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All AI features disable via single flag; runtime operates identically to static runtime
requirements.technical_notes: --no-ai flag. Compile-time feature flag for minimal binary.

requirements.title: AI explainability
requirements.description: Log reasoning for every AI action
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every AI action logged with reasoning; "ferrocrate explain <decision-id>" command
requirements.technical_notes: Decision log with full context. Queryable by decision ID.

requirements.title: GPU/VRAM scheduling
requirements.description: Intelligent GPU resource allocation for AI workloads
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Detect NVIDIA/AMD GPUs; intelligent VRAM allocation for LLM containers
requirements.technical_notes: Query GPU info via NVML/ROCm. Track VRAM allocation per container.
requirements.verification: GPU detection tests, VRAM allocation tests

requirements.title: Docker-compatible CLI
requirements.description: Match Docker CLI syntax for common commands
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ferrocrate run, build, pull, push, ps, logs, exec match Docker behavior
requirements.technical_notes: Use clap for argument parsing. Mirror Docker flag names.

requirements.title: Docker socket compatibility
requirements.description: Emulate Docker API for tool compatibility
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Emulate /var/run/docker.sock for tools expecting Docker API
requirements.technical_notes: Unix socket server implementing Docker API v1.45+.

requirements.title: Shell completion
requirements.description: Generate shell completion scripts
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Tab completion for commands, images, container names
requirements.technical_notes: clap complete subcommand. Generate for bash, zsh, fish.

requirements.title: Human-friendly output
requirements.description: Colored output with progress indicators
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Progress bars for pulls; table formatting for ps/images
requirements.technical_notes: Use indicatif for progress. Use comfy-table for tables.

requirements.title: JSON output mode
requirements.description: Machine-parseable JSON output
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Machine-parseable output for scripting
requirements.technical_notes: --format json flag. Structured output for all commands.

requirements.title: Migration tool
requirements.description: Scan Docker and generate equivalent ferrocrate config
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Scan Docker installation; generate ferrocrate-equivalent configuration
requirements.technical_notes: Read Docker configs, volumes, networks. Generate migration report.

requirements.title: Interactive TUI
requirements.description: Terminal UI for container management
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Terminal UI for browsing containers, logs, resources
requirements.technical_notes: Use ratatui for TUI. Real-time updates via tokio.
